First, note the date format: 11-25-1399 is MM-DD-YYYY, so it's 1399-11-25 in ISO format.  

Subtract 124 days:  

1399 is not a leap year (leap years in Julian calendar? Actually 1399 is pre-Gregorian, but we use Gregorian arithmetic as per rules).  
1399 is not divisible by 4 → common year.  

Start: 1399-11-25  
Go back 25 days → 1399-10-31  
Remaining days to subtract: 124 - 25 = 99 days left.  

October has 31 days, so from 1399-10-31 back 31 days → 1399-09-30  
Remaining: 99 - 31 = 68 days left.  

September has 30 days, back 30 days → 1399-08-31  
Remaining: 68 - 30 = 38 days left.  

August has 31 days, back 31 days → 1399-07-31  
Remaining: 38 - 31 = 7 days left.  

Back 7 days from 1399-07-31 → 1399-07-24.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1399-07-24
